propositions: ProviderSession construction at runner.py:294 sits outside the try-guard that begins at runner.py:445, causing httpx.AsyncClient leaks when pre-call code like _check_tool_capability raises before the finally block at runner.py:501

ProviderSession.__enter__ and __exit__ context manager methods exist at providers.py:323/326 but are never used, while providers.py docstring claims runner.run() wraps its body in with ProviderSession

The stub _NoBuildProviderSession in test_execution_mode_dispatch.py implements __init__, supports, is_resolvable, and close but lacks __enter__/__exit__, causing runtime failure once run() is wrapped in a with statement
The security check assert_gated at runner.py:261 must execute before any provider client is constructed to maintain fail-closed semantics
Wrapping run() with ProviderSession as a context manager eliminates the need for the redundant finally: provider_session.close() block and guarantees cleanup even if pre-call code raises
